summary: Completed comprehensive testing of OTP (One-Time Password) feature for Mobile Money payments (Orange Money and MTN Money). All OTP functionality working correctly as per requirements.

TEST 2: OTP section visible for Orange Money with orange styling - PASSED
TEST 6: OTP section visible for MTN Money with yellow styling - PASSED

TEST 8: OTP section hidden for Chèque - PASSED
phone_prefill_tests: TEST 3: Phone number auto-prefilled from selected customer (Mamadou Camara: +224 622 10 20 30) - PASSED
otp_flow_tests: TEST 4: OTP input field appears after clicking 'Demander le code OTP' - PASSED
TEST 5: OTP verification with demo code '123456' shows 'Paiement autorisé' badge - PASSED

ui_styling_tests: Orange Money OTP section has orange background and orange button
MTN Money OTP section has yellow background and yellow button
Verified OTP state shows green background with 'Paiement autorisé' badge

critical_code_review_comments: OTP implementation is a frontend MOCK/SIMULATION - no actual backend API integration
Demo code '123456' is hardcoded for testing purposes
OTP countdown timer works correctly (60 seconds before resend allowed)
Phone number pre-fill from customer data works correctly
Color schemes properly differentiate Orange Money (orange) vs MTN Money (yellow) vs Verified (green)
seed_data_creation: Used existing customer 'Mamadou Camara' with phone '+224 622 10 20 30' for phone pre-fill testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP feature for Mobile Money payments fully tested. Key points: 1) OTP section only appears for 'orange_money' and 'mtn_money' payment methods. 2) Phone number is auto-prefilled from selected customer's phone. 3) Demo OTP code is '123456'. 4) OTP validation is required before sale can be completed for Mobile Money. 5) Countdown timer (60s) prevents immediate resend. 6) This is a MOCKED frontend implementation - no actual backend OTP API exists.
mocked_api_note: IMPORTANT: The OTP system is entirely MOCKED on the frontend. handleRequestOtp and handleVerifyOtp functions simulate OTP behavior with setTimeout delays. In production, these would need to be replaced with actual Mobile Money API integrations.
